target_pattern: Place color adjectives after nouns, apply agreement rules by color type, use shade patterns claro/oscuro after the color, and leverage color + noun construction when agreement is uncertain.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Keeping one fixed color form and English adjective order.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish color words follow noun position and rule-based agreement patterns, with safe alternatives for invariable forms.
target_pattern_formula: shade suffix after color: verde claro, azul oscuro
natural_examples: La mochila naranja esta en la oficina.

controlled_recombination.instructions: Write each in Spanish using correct color placement and agreement.
prompts_en: The sky is gray this morning.
I bought a backpack color pink.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: la camisa roja -> change noun to plural camisas.
Base: el coche negro -> change noun to feminine singular moto.
Base: los zapatos azules -> change noun to singular zapato.
Base: la pared gris -> change noun to plural paredes.
Base: el pez naranja -> change noun to plural peces.
Base: la flor purpura -> change noun to plural flores.
Base: la camisa verde claro -> change to dark green.
Base: los zapatos azul oscuro -> change to light blue.
Base: la casa es blanca -> change predicate color to amarilla.
Base: la planta esta verde hoy -> change to esta amarilla hoy.
Base: la puerta es azul normalmente -> change to plural subject.
Base: compre una mochila color rosa -> change noun to zapatos.
Base: el perro color cafe -> rewrite using adjective agreement form.
Base: tengo ojos castanos -> change to hair expression with castano.
Base: el oso pardo vive en el bosque -> change animal to plural.

prompts: the red house (la casa roja vs la roja casa)
the black dogs (los perros negros vs los perros negro)
the green apples (las manzanas verdes vs las manzanas verde)
the orange backpack (la mochila naranja vs la mochila naranjas)
the purple flowers (las flores purpura vs las flores purpuras)
dark blue shoes (los zapatos azul oscuro vs los zapatos azules oscuros in this lesson pattern)
The shirt is red. (La camisa es roja. vs La camisa esta roja for default trait)
The plant is green today. (La planta esta verde hoy. vs La planta es verde hoy)
I bought green pants. (Compre unos pantalones color verde. vs Compre unos pantalones verdes color.)
brown eyes (ojos castanos vs ojos cafe as default taught context)

common_errors.why_it_happens: Missing plural agreement on variable color.
Not matching variable color with feminine noun.

common_errors.mistake: la planta es verde hoy for temporary state
common_errors.why_it_happens: Confusing ser with estar in context.

common_errors.correct_spanish: Use safe frame color + color word.

common_errors.mistake: using castano for all brown objects

common_errors.correct_spanish: pardo appears in limited contexts like oso pardo.
